framework_threshold.note: No extra documents; all 33 listed pages viewed. No safety or scaling framework in the card (pre-dates Preparedness Framework); only the OpenAI Charter is cited in a footnote (p18), which is not a framework with thresholds.

ext_test_government.note: Red teamers and ARC are non-government; no AISI or government body in any page.

safeguards_access.note: 'access controls' appears only in the system-card footnote 1 (p2) as a generic non-model mitigation; 'Access to and use of our models are also subject to OpenAI's Terms of Use' (p26) is a terms gate, not a risk-tied restriction.

safeguards_weights.note: No weight protection; self-replication is evaluated by ARC but no weight security is stated on any page.
